# Scraper de Domain.com.au

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/domaincom-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/domaincom-scraper.md)

Scraper de exemplo que coleta dados de anúncios de imóveis do Domain.com.au, escrito em Python com a API de web scraping do [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/). Faz parte do [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.pt-BR.md).

- **Guia:** [How to Scrape Domain.com.au Real Estate Property Data](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-domain-com-au-real-estate-property-data)
- **Código:** [`domaincom.py`](domaincom.py) · **Execução de exemplo:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Testes:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Saída de exemplo:** [Property pages](results/properties.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## O que ele extrai

- Busca de imóveis do Domain.com.au para encontrar anúncios de imóveis
- Páginas de imóveis do Domain.com.au para dados de anúncios de imóveis

## Funções

- `scrape_properties(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape listing data from property pages
- `scrape_search(url, max_scrape_pages=None)`: scrape property listings from search pages

As funções são `async`: execute-as com `asyncio.run(...)` ou use `await`.

### Exemplo

As entradas são os exemplos de [`run.py`](run.py) (listas longas encurtadas):

```python
import asyncio
import domaincom


async def main():
    search = await domaincom.scrape_search(
        url="https://www.domain.com.au/sale/melbourne-vic-3000/",
        max_scrape_pages=1,
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Saída

As funções retornam dicionários e listas simples. Campos da saída de exemplo (chaves de primeiro nível do primeiro item):

- [`results/properties.json`](results/properties.json): `listingId`, `listingUrl`, `unitNumber`, `streetNumber`, `street`, `suburb`, `postcode`, `createdOn`, `propertyType`, `beds`, `phone`, `agencyName`, `propertyDeveloperName`, `agencyProfileUrl`, `propertyDeveloperUrl`, `description`, `loanfinder`, `schools`, `suburbInsights`, `gallery`, `listingSummary`, `agents`, `features`, `structuredFeatures`, `faqs`, `url`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `id`, `listingType`, `listingModel`

## Configurações do Scrapfly

`BASE_CONFIG` em [`domaincom.py`](domaincom.py) contém as configurações padrão das requisições; veja a [documentação da Scrape API](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: o [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker) do Scrapfly, que contorna proteções anti-bot
- `country` = `"AU"`: país do proxy
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: pool de proxies (datacenter ou residencial)

## Início rápido

Requer Python 3.10+ e [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/domaincom-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # em https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # scraping de exemplo, salva a saída em ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # os testes deste scraper
```

Testes: `test_properties_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; para executar um, use `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` e os testes fazem scraping do site real, por isso consomem créditos do Scrapfly.
